items.title: Parse greeting templates
items.goal: Add src/greet/parser.ts that splits a template such as "Hello, {name}!" into text and placeholder parts, and tests/greet/parser.test.ts. An unclosed brace throws ParseError. Change no other file.

dod.text: Templates parse into parts and an unclosed brace throws ParseError: bun test tests/greet/parser.test.ts

items.title: Render greetings from parsed templates
items.goal: Add src/greet/render.ts that fills the placeholders of parsed parts from a record, and tests/greet/render.test.ts. A missing value throws RenderError naming the placeholder. Change no other file.

dod.text: Placeholders are filled and a missing value throws RenderError: bun test tests/greet/render.test.ts

items.title: Print a greeting from the command line
items.goal: Add src/greet/cli.ts that takes a template and name=value pairs from argv and prints the rendered greeting, and tests/greet/cli.ts. Change no other file.

dod.text: bun run src/greet/cli.ts "Hi {name}" name=Ada prints Hi Ada
Usage errors exit 2: bun test tests/greet/cli.test.ts
